# Hunexture

> Hunexture is an Ahmedabad-based software company building custom AI & ML solutions, web and mobile apps, and cloud platforms for startups and enterprises worldwide. Contact: info@hunexture.com, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India.

Hunexture offers AI Solutions, Web Development, App Development, Cloud Integration, UI/UX Design, Digital Marketing. Pages below are available as Markdown (.md); the whole site is in one file at https://hunexture.com/llms-full.txt.

## Company
- [Home](https://hunexture.com/index.md): Hunexture is an Ahmedabad-based software company building custom AI & ML solutions, web and mobile apps, and cloud platforms for startups and enterprises worldwide.
